verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS research platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents uploading to a data storage service and notes that chat-session sandboxes can expire, but it shows no user-facing way to set retention periods or delete stored data, tasks or sessions. Sandbox expiry is a platform behavior, not a user control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
